question: What is the ruling on: the per owner database comes before more complexity?
why_it_blocks: answered before the question door existed; migrated into the corpus so the system reads its Q&A in one place
answer:
no we're going to need that before sharing it for real with the world. so time for a use case. In my vision, we have one or more 'top level agents' like you, with different specialties. Librarian is one. 'Igor' is one. [...] In my own household there's me, and Leah, my wife... And probably an igor, and perhaps other specialized agents as well that I can't imagine yet. so the problem of who owns what takes on a new dimension. now imagine a lab where the igor helps everybody in the lab. with all kinds of different things, some of them perhaps even requiring security clearences. and things like that change over time, so the igors would have to be adaptable.
no, the per owner database is a thing we do before things become even more complicated
